title: CDC situation summary lists 9,277 confirmed DRC cases and 4,478 deaths
detail: CDC's Ebola situation summary lists 9,277 confirmed cases and 4,478 confirmed deaths in the DRC, with no probable cases counted. An earlier CDC count (as of 15 October) was 9,212 DRC cases and 4,441 deaths, and the DRC Health Ministry reported 9,066 cases and 4,381 deaths as of 11 October (CFR 48.3%). Ituri accounts for about 73.8% of confirmed cases; seven provinces are affected. Figures differ by source date and are still being revised.
